title: RiskDrive™ by Affinity Risk
description: Cover slide — full-bleed tow truck hero image with navy overlay and tagline
speakerNotes:
• Welcome the audience and introduce yourself and Affinity Risk Solutions — the program administrator purpose-built for AAA towing networks.
• RiskDrive™ is a telematics-based insurance intelligence platform: it replaces carrier guesswork with real driving data.
• Today's presentation covers the problem, how the platform works, and what it means for your premiums.
• The core promise: connect your existing Samsara or Geotab devices and get right-sized premiums based on what your drivers actually do.
• Invite any questions at the end — the goal is to show you exactly how this applies to your club.

title: Towing Insurance Is Broken
description: Problem slide — 4 pain points in a 2×2 card grid
speakerNotes:
• Today's towing insurance market prices fleets on industry averages and loss-run history, not on how your specific drivers actually behave — good operators subsidize bad ones.
• One difficult loss year can lock your network out of preferred markets for several renewal cycles, forcing you into surplus lines at significantly higher cost.
• The contractor classification issue is a hidden liability: many clubs use 1099 tower relationships that expose them to misclassification penalties under state labor law.
• When a disputed claim hits, the telematics and dashcam evidence that could exonerate your driver is often already overwritten or inaccessible — turning defensible incidents into paid settlements.
• All four of these problems have a single root cause: no real-time data connecting driver behavior to insurance decisions. That's exactly what RiskDrive™ fixes.

title: From Telematics Data to Lower Premiums
description: Three-step process on a navy background
speakerNotes:
• Step 1 — Connect: if your fleet already runs Samsara or Geotab, setup takes minutes. We validate credentials and pull live vehicle, driver, and safety-event data immediately — no hardware changes required.
• Step 2 — Score: RiskDrive™ continuously turns that live data into a composite risk score weighted across safety behavior, compliance status, telematics adoption, and training completion.
• Step 3 — Save: a higher score opens access to 6–8 preferred carrier markets simultaneously. Carriers compete for your business, which is what drives premiums down — up to 22% versus standard market pricing.
• The entire cycle is ongoing, not a one-time snapshot. As your drivers improve, your score improves, and your next renewal reflects that improvement.
• This is fundamentally different from the annual loss-run review your current broker relies on.

title: The RiskDrive™ Score
description: Score breakdown — 4 weighted components with bar chart and tier table
speakerNotes:
• The score is a composite of four factors, each weighted by its actuarial impact on towing losses: Safety & Behavior (40%), Compliance & Onboarding (30%), Telematics Adoption (20%), and Training Completion (10%).
• Safety & Behavior is the largest driver — speeding, hard braking, phone use, and fatigue events are the leading indicators of costly claims in the towing segment.
• The tier table on the right shows what each score band unlocks: an 80+ score opens every preferred market; 70–79 gives access to 6–8 preferred carriers; 55–69 gives standard market access; below 55 limits your options.
• Networks using RiskDrive™ are already averaging 14% savings versus the industry benchmark across the portfolio.
• The score updates continuously on a 90-day rolling window, so improvement is reflected at your next renewal — not three years from now.

title: Workers' Comp Built for Tow Operators
description: WC benefits — 5 bullets plus savings and turnaround callout cards
speakerNotes:
• Workers' comp for towing is a specialty market — most standard carriers either won't write it or misprice it significantly because they don't understand the class codes.
• RiskDrive™ WC is exclusively underwritten by AmTrust, which is the nation's leading towing workers' comp carrier. This is a dedicated program, not a general commercial placement.
• Premium is calculated on actual payroll by class code, so you're not overpaying on estimated unit counts that don't match your real exposure.
• Critically, the policy covers both 1099 contractors and W-2 employees under one structure — eliminating the misclassification gap that creates legal exposure for clubs.
• With clean telematics data, WC savings of 8–22% vs. the standard market are typical, and quotes come back in 24 hours.

title: Claims That Pay You Back
description: Claims slide — full-bleed dashcam image with 25% exoneration stat hero
speakerNotes:
• The claims process starts the moment an incident occurs: RiskDrive™ automatically secures telematics and dashcam evidence before it can be overwritten — this is non-negotiable in the first hour.
• Every claim moves through a single FNOL-to-resolution pipeline, so nothing falls through the cracks between your club, the carrier, and the TPA.
• Dedicated TPA partners handle reserves, litigation strategy, and settlement negotiations — your team doesn't need to manage the claims process directly.
• The stat on this slide tells the real story: 25% of network claims are fully exonerated — meaning the driver is proven not at fault and the claim is closed at $0. That's dashcam and telematics evidence doing the work.
• A single exoneration on a serious liability claim can easily save $50,000–$100,000. That evidence collection pays for the entire platform many times over.

title: Compliance on Autopilot
description: Four compliance features in a 2×2 card grid
speakerNotes:
• Compliance failures are the silent premium killer: a lapsed COI, an expired CDL, or a driver with an unreported violation can each void coverage mid-policy or blow up a renewal.
• AI-powered COI extraction means your team uploads a certificate and the system reads it — no manual data entry, no transcription errors, no missed fields.
• Automatic expiration alerts fire before any certificate or license lapses, so coverage never goes dark without your knowledge.
• Continuous MVR monitoring watches for violations and CDL status changes in real time — not just at renewal. A DUI caught two months post-hire is caught now, not at your next loss run review.
• Onboarding checklists ensure every new operator is verified road-ready before their first dispatch, removing the administrative burden from facility managers.

title: Your Entire AAA Network, One Dashboard
description: Dashboard overview — bullet list left, live score panel right
speakerNotes:
• For a regional AAA club managing multiple tow facilities, the dashboard gives you a single command center: one login, every facility's score, incident trends, and training completion status.
• The right panel shows a live network view — you can see immediately which facilities are performing well (Detroit at 84) and which need attention (Akron at 58), and drill into the specific drivers pulling the score down.
• Finn, the built-in AI guide, can answer questions about WC policy interpretation, compliance requirements, and score improvement strategies in plain language — no insurance expertise required.
• Demo mode lets your team explore the platform with realistic sample data before you go live, so there's no learning curve on day one.
• The network average is 70.4 in this example — already in the preferred-carrier band. The goal is to move every facility above 70 and into the 80+ tier within 12 months.

title: Ready to Lower Your Fleet's Risk?
description: Closing slide — CTA with URL on navy background
speakerNotes:

• Once you see your score and the carrier options it unlocks, you'll have a clear picture of what your renewal should look like versus what you're paying today.
